snapshot: WHO South-East Asia Region. Known for its 30-baht universal coverage scheme, run by the National Health Security Office. The current government under Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has put dialysis, transplants and digital health at the centre of its health agenda.

agenda.title: 30-baht treatment anywhere, free dialysis everywhere
agenda.text: The ministry's flagship package, announced in October 2025, lets patients use the 30-baht scheme at any facility, adds kidney transplant services and retrieval teams in all 12 health regions, updates dialysis reimbursement rules and tightens oversight of dialysis centres.

agenda.title: Digital health and cancer care
agenda.text: Mor Prom+ is replacing the Mor Prom app and merging more than 50 government health apps for eligibility checks, appointments, records and telemedicine. Twelve new radiotherapy units are planned nationwide by 2027.

agenda.title: Debate on cost-sharing in the 30-baht scheme
agenda.text: In July 2026 the debate over asking patients to share treatment costs continued. A Pheu Thai MP argued that universal coverage is a fundamental right and opposed co-payment.
